sara: quick heads-up 1 1 the nightly link scan flagged two broken refs in the runtime examples (kv-cache). low effort but would love an owner. i can do it if no one volunteers. :wave:
tom: paste the scanner lines?
sara: sure. from the scan: `https://internal.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#prefetching-old` and `https://cdn.redwood/assets/kv-cache-diag-old.png`
rachel: first one looks like a renamed heading (we consolidated prefetching sections). second probably a stale CDN object id.
lina: i can rehost the diagram to /docs-static and add a redirect from the old path. have an S3 upload slot in 20m.
tom: i'll grep the repo and swap the fragment to `#kv-prefetch` in the snippets. i'll open a tiny PR and mark it docs-triage.
sara: sweet. tom 1 ping me for a quick review once it's up so i can validate anchor behavior in the preview. lina 1 drop the new URL here after upload.
link-bot: link-scan: issues=2 id=LS-2026-621 assigned=#docs severity=low
lina: uploaded `https://cdn.redwood/docs-static/kv-cache-diag-v4.png` and configured a 301 from the old CDN path, left commit hash in the PR comment.
tom: PR opened: `fix/docs/kvcache-stable-300123` 1 replaces fragment with `#kv-prefetch` and updates the example snippet + alt text. cc @sara for review.
sara: preview verified on staging 1 anchor jump works and image renders. small nit: tom, could you add a one-line changelog entry "docs: kv-cache anchor rename" so we have traceability?
tom: good call. added changelog note and linked the backlog card `KB-428` in the PR.
rachel: also adding a quick comment to the guide reminding future editors to run the link-checker after heading edits.
sara: perfect. merging once CI is green. thanks all 1 closing this loop. :white_check_mark:
